text: Hager Group describes itself as an independent family-owned and family-run company based in Blieskastel, Germany; Hager SE is named as a director (dirigeant) of the French company Hager Electro SAS (Obernai, SIREN 675 980 114).
short: Hager Group is an independent family company (Hager family, Germany).

source.name: Hager Group: Everything you need to know about us
source.quote: As an independent family-owned and family-run company based in Blieskastel, Germany, we are one of the industry's innovation leaders.
